Ceropsora_Weirii.quote: Pale orange to white, tube-like projections appear on infected needles in July or August and release powdery, orange spores.

Rhizosphaera_Needle_Cast.quote: Tiny black bumps can be seen arranged in neat rows on infected needles.

Sirococcus_Blight.quote: infected needles, shoot tips and one year old twigs wither, turn brown and fall off
Infections on expanding shoots often cause the shoot to curl downward in a shepherd's crook
